prompt: A class with a `__len__` returning 0 in an `if`. True or false?
hint: `__bool__` falls back.

choices.text: True
choices.why: Existence is not what is being asked.

choices.text: It depends on whether `__eq__` is defined
choices.why: `__eq__` has nothing to do with truthiness.

choices.text: It raises
choices.why: The fallback answers.

choices.text: False
choices.why: Right — and it surprises almost everybody once.

prompt: What is wrong with a `@staticmethod` that uses neither the class nor the instance?
hint: It is in a class for tidiness only.

choices.text: It has to be listed in `__all__`
choices.why: Nothing requires that.

choices.text: A module-level function was the honest answer
choices.why: Right — the namespace already existed.

choices.text: It cannot be called from an instance
choices.why: It can, and that is not the complaint.

choices.text: It cannot take arguments
choices.why: It takes as many as you like.

prompt: A property whose getter and setter both use the name `score` produces what?
hint: The setter calls something.

choices.text: A silent shadowing of the property
choices.why: Nothing is shadowed; it recurses.

choices.text: An `AttributeError`
choices.why: The recursion happens before anything is missing.

choices.text: A `RecursionError`
choices.why: Right — the stored name has to differ.

choices.text: Nothing; the names are allowed to match
choices.why: They are allowed and they loop.

prompt: Two instances of the same class, same field values, no `__eq__`. Are they equal?
hint: The inherited comparison asks a different question.

choices.text: It raises, because no comparison is defined
choices.why: The inherited one answers.

choices.text: Yes, because the fields match
choices.why: Nothing compares the fields yet.

choices.text: No
choices.why: Right — the default `==` compares identity.

choices.text: Yes, if the class is a dataclass — and a dataclass is not required here
choices.why: A dataclass would say yes, and the question is about a plain class.
